items.title: Sealed secret execution for AI agents
items.raw_excerpt: Your AI agent needs real keys, database URLs, and credentials to work. ironrun keeps them in a local encrypted workspace, grants the agent time-boxed access, and runs every command sealed: secrets injected below the agent, redacted from everything it sees. Open source, MIT.

title_i18n.en: Sealed secret execution for AI agents
title_i18n.zh: 面向AI代理的密封秘密执行
title_i18n.es: Ejecución secreta sellada para agentes de IA

excerpt_i18n.en: Your AI agent needs real keys, database URLs, and credentials to work. ironrun keeps them in a local encrypted workspace, grants the agent time-boxed access, and runs every command sealed: secrets injected below the agent, redacted from everything it sees. Open source, MIT.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 你的AI代理需要真实的密钥、数据库URL和凭据才能工作。ironrun将它们保存在本地加密工作区中，授予代理有时间限制的访问权限，并密封运行每个命令：机密注入在代理下方。
excerpt_i18n.es: Tu agente de IA necesita claves reales, URL de bases de datos y credenciales para funcionar. ironrun las mantiene en un espacio de trabajo local cifrado, concede al agente acceso limitado en el tiempo y ejecuta cada comando sellado: los secretos se inyectan por debajo del agente.

items.title: How we measured AI writing across arXiv, and where the measurement breaks
items.raw_excerpt: We scored the full text of 12,750 arXiv papers and found that about a third of new ones read as machine-written. Here is the method, the results, and an honest account of the limitations.

title_i18n.en: How we measured AI writing across arXiv, and where the measurement breaks
title_i18n.zh: 我们如何测量 arXiv 上 AI 写作的占比，以及测量在何处失效
title_i18n.es: Cómo medimos la escritura de la IA en arXiv, y dónde falla la medición

excerpt_i18n.en: We scored the full text of 12,750 arXiv papers and found that about a third of new ones read as machine-written. Here is the method, the results, and an honest account of the limitations.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 我们对12,750篇arXiv论文的全文进行了评分，发现大约三分之一的新论文读起来像是机器写的。以下是我们使用的方法、得到的结果以及对局限性的坦诚说明。
excerpt_i18n.es: Analizamos el texto completo de 12.750 artículos de arXiv y descubrimos que alrededor de un tercio de los nuevos parecen escritos por una máquina. A continuación, el método, los resultados y un relato honesto de las limitaciones.

items.title: Bloomy (YC S26) – AI-powered mastery learning for K-12
items.raw_excerpt: Hi HN, I’m Alex Southmayd, the founder of Bloomy ( https://bloomylearning.com ) – an AI-powered mastery-learning platform for K-12 students. Bloomy provides students with an AI tutor alongside adaptive curriculum (right now Math, English Language Arts, and Writing). How it works: we diagnose students’ skill gaps, place them on personalized learning paths, and give them standards-aligned lessons and a Socratic AI tutor that scaffolds their learning without just giving away the answer. The goal is to solve the Bloom 2-sigma problem ( https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bloom%27s_2_sigma_problem ) with AI.
